title: Global market source attestation reconciliation
protectedPrinciple: Never rewrite or backdate the four legacy receipts. Attach this audit overlay and exclude them from strict clean prospective denominator until independent raw-source response evidence exists.

results.explanation: Deterministic receipt hashes and a digest chain prove internal consistency of the stored manifest, not original provider response bytes, signed publication time, archival immutability or first-known clock. GitHub file commit at 2026-09-30T05:24:29+08:00 bounds when the manifest was durably written but does not prove the earlier asserted 05:20:18 capture.

updatedPublicObservations.purpose: Cross-check source continuity and timestamp semantics without fabricating a provider-response receipt.

tests.strictSourceAttestationScope: A genuinely clean observation also requires independently obtained raw archived bytes and honest transport/entitlement metadata; code alone cannot certify that provider data or storage claims are authentic.

falsification: Receipt JSON declares capturedAt but original provider response body was not preserved.
Hash-only manifests do not prove immutable first-known source availability.
Current official numeric match does not establish an historical source-response byte match.
Cross-checking October 1 yields on October 2 is not evidence the October 1 Taiwan 18:10 decision knew them.
The 2026-09-30 pilot is one partial manifest date, not four independent dates.
Neither 2026-09-30 nor 2026-10-01 real VIX/18:10 TX receipts were located in the audited room checkpoint.
next: Collect authorized raw bytes and response metadata for next real source-only prospective date.

additionalLegacyMacroScheduleArtifact.note: The 2026-10-01 ISM, BLS, BEA and FOMC schedule vintage was preserved before its 18:10 decision in the room research manifest.
